dedupe_keys.name: serbia register of issued and expired energy permits ministry of mining and energy solar and hydro plants gas pipelines fuel storage

description: Serbia's Ministry of Mining and Energy keeps an online register of issued energy permits and of energy permits that have ceased to be valid. Each entry, read on 2026-09-29, gives the permit holder, the facility name, the facility type (for example solar power plant, small hydro plant, gas distribution pipeline, or storage of oil, petroleum products, biofuel, CNG and LPG over 10 m³), the permit decision number, the date of issue and the status (valid or expired); recent entries date from 2024 and 2025, such as solar plants at Doljevac, Kučevo and Brestovac. The register can be filtered and exported to XLS. The ministry's site also links a register of privileged (renewable) power producers and a register of biofuel obligors, and publishes annual security of supply reports for electricity, gas and oil. Coverage: national, Serbia. Format and access: web register with XLS export, free, no login; Serbian in Cyrillic with Latin company names. Licence: not stated. Caveats: an energy permit shows intent to build, not commissioning, and entries carry no capacities or coordinates; the privileged producers register returned HTTP 403 to the cloud. Simulation uses: capacity planning of planned generation and fuel storage. Related records: compare with Poland's liquid fuel infrastructure registers (data-ure-liquid-fuel-infrastructure-registers-poland).
